phase: PASS scoped authorized real-browser verification; coordinated global suite remains ReleaseDocs responsibility
review_repairs: Same-configuration duplicate start returns already_active; changed configuration rejects with stop/start instruction. Listener cleanup errors return bounded safe codes; background task exceptions are retrieved and recorded. Startup failure and cleanup fault-only unit fixtures added. Websocket metadata explicitly limits scope to main-page CDP target, excluding workers/OOP child frame targets.

contract.start: async start(page, tab_id, kind='network', max_events=256, url_filter=None, payloads=False, max_payload_bytes=512) -> dict
contract.filter: literal substring of sanitized URL, no regex
contract.cursor: monotonic per-capture event integer; bounded history exposes dropped/cursor_gap/oldest_cursor/latest_cursor
contract.payloads: websocket text only, explicit requested flag AND host BROWSER_MONITOR_PAYLOADS=1; best-effort bounded redaction, no binary data

research.schema: request, response, requestfinished, requestfailed; HTTP503 completes normally; redirect produces new Request.redirected_from; timing contains startTime and relative millisecond timing fields

webSocketCreated, HandshakeResponseReceived, FrameSent/Received, FrameError, Closed; WebSocketFrame opcode and payloadData; opcode1 UTF8 otherwise base64; represents entire message not fragmented wire frame

security: No HTTP bodies, postdata, cookies, auth or headers exposed. URL userinfo/query/fragment removed, protected schemes suppressed. Request tracking uses bounded weak references. Socket metadata/rings bounded. Text payloads contain explicit redaction limitation warning. No interception.

verification.authorization: Main lifted verification gate for runtime owners before execution
verification.first_run: 4 passed, 1 failed in 13.31s; genuine protocol ping9/automatic pong10 omitted by Chromium CDP; actual events only opcodes1/2. No fabricated replacement events.
verification.repair: Parent explicitly accepted platform limitation; expose control_frame_visibility=not_guaranteed_by_cdp. Test genuine protocol ping while accepting actual CDP opcodes; separately prove outgoing text ping and incoming text pong, both opcode1.
verification.browser_fixtures: Real local asyncio HTTP503/redirect/blocked-port requestfailed and RFC6455 echo/ping/binary/error/close; browser UI deliberately does not display traffic results. HTTP status vs failed, redirect correlation, other-tab exclusion, bounded cursor gap/filter, stop/page-close teardown, open/close/error inventory, late attach, host consent/redaction, binary metadata and injected failure-only cleanup covered.
verification.screenshot_review: Both independent screenshots inspected: Quiet UI and Request/Socket/End/Error buttons only, no network status/message contents; event JSON contains actual capture metadata.
verification.evidence_boundary: Machine-local pytest temporary artifacts; not durable public links; no raw payloads or private screenshots committed

limitations: Monitoring is prospective; preexisting requests and sockets may be incomplete
Websocket scope is main-page CDP target; worker and out-of-process child-frame sockets explicitly excluded in metadata
CDP WebSocket messages do not expose fragmented-wire-frame boundaries
Text redaction cannot guarantee removal of arbitrary secrets
Actual Chromium CDP omitted protocol control ping9/pong10 from genuine server-ping fixture; text ping/pong opcode1 succeeds; returned control_frame_visibility explicitly not guaranteed
